caption: Figure 13.2 Diagrammatic representation of locations of root apical meristem, shoot aplical meristem and vascular cambium. Arrows exhibit the direction of growth of cells and organ
note: Labelled diagram of a shoot and a root with leader lines. "Vascular cambium" is printed twice, once for the shoot and once for the root. "aplical" is the spelling printed in the caption. Page number 168 and the body text in the right column are not part of this figure.
